mapper.insert: -- Record local-government URL and schedule changes without response bodies or secrets. INSERT INTO audit_logs (actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json) VALUES (#{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson} AS jsonb))
mapper.sql: lgns.id AS source_id, lgns.public_code, lgns.sido_code, lgns.sido_name, lgns.sigungu_code, lgns.sigungu_name, lgns.institution_type_code, lgns.institution_name, lgns.homepage_url, lgns.notice_url, lgns.collection_endpoint_url, lgns.page_type_code, lgns.request_profile_code, lgns.request_method_code, lgns.request_form_json::text AS request_form_json, lgns.parser_profile_code, lgnpp.profile_name AS parser_profile_name, lgns.collection_hint, lgns.confidence_code, lgns.validation_status_code, lgns.source_board_type_code, lgns.collection_policy_code, lgns.is_semantically_verified, lgns.semantic_verified_at, lgns.semantic_verified_by, lgns.semantic_verification_note, lgns.is_enabled, lgns.collection_status_code, lgns.last_collected_at, lgns.last_success_at, lgns.last_http_status, lgns.last_error_code, lgns.last_error_message, lgns.etag, lgns.last_modified_value, lgns.last_content_fingerprint, latest_result.result_status_code AS latest_result_status_code, latest_result.discovered_count AS latest_result_discovered_count, latest_result.failed_count AS latest_result_failed_count, latest_result.excluded_count AS latest_result_excluded_count, latest_result.finished_at AS latest_result_finished_at, lgns.created_at, lgns.updated_at, lgns.deleted_at

LEFT JOIN local_government_notice_parser_profiles lgnpp ON lgnpp.profile_code = lgns.parser_profile_code LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT result.result_status_code, result.discovered_count, result.failed_count, result.excluded_count, result.finished_at FROM announcement_source_collection_source_results result WHERE result.local_government_source_id = lgns.id ORDER BY result.started_at DESC, result.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_result ON true

ass.id AS schedule_id, ass.public_code, ass.provider_code, ass.schedule_name, ass.cron_expression, ass.timezone, ass.schedule_status_code, ass.max_count, ass.requested_by, ass.approved_by, ass.approved_at, ass.approval_note, ass.last_run_at, ass.next_run_at, ass.created_at, ass.updated_at
mapper.insert: -- Register a local-government notice source with the system-managed parser in disabled state. INSERT INTO local_government_notice_sources ( id, sido_code, sido_name, sigungu_code, sigungu_name, institution_type_code, institution_name, homepage_url, notice_url, collection_endpoint_url, page_type_code, request_profile_code, parser_profile_code, collection_hint, confidence_code, validation_status_code, source_board_type_code, collection_policy_code, is_semantically_verified, semantic_verified_at, semantic_verified_by, semantic_verification_note, is_enabled, collection_status_code, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, #{sidoCode}, #{sidoName}, #{sigunguCode}, #{sigunguName}, #{institutionTypeCode}, #{institutionName}, #{homepageUrl}, #{noticeUrl}, #{collectionEndpointUrl}, #{pageTypeCode}, #{requestProfileCode}, #{parserProfileCode}, #{collectionHint}, #{confidenceCode}, #{validationStatusCode}, #{sourceBoardTypeCode}, #{collectionPolicyCode}, #{semanticallyVerified}, CASE WHEN #{semanticallyVerified} THEN now() ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{semanticallyVerified} THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE NULL END, #{semanticVerificationNote}, false, 'CHECK_REQUIRED', #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update source metadata while preserving the system-managed parser and current ON/OFF state. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources SET sido_code = #{sidoCode}, sido_name = #{sidoName}, sigungu_code = #{sigunguCode}, sigungu_name = #{sigunguName}, institution_type_code = #{institutionTypeCode}, institution_name = #{institutionName}, homepage_url = #{homepageUrl}, notice_url = #{noticeUrl}, collection_endpoint_url = #{collectionEndpointUrl}, page_type_code = #{pageTypeCode}, request_profile_code = #{requestProfileCode}, parser_profile_code = #{parserProfileCode}, collection_hint = #{collectionHint}, confidence_code = #{confidenceCode}, validation_status_code = #{validationStatusCode}, source_board_type_code = #{sourceBoardTypeCode}, collection_policy_code = #{collectionPolicyCode}, is_semantically_verified = #{semanticallyVerified}, semantic_verified_at = CASE WHEN #{semanticallyVerified} THEN coalesce(semantic_verified_at, now()) ELSE NULL END, semantic_verified_by = CASE WHEN #{semanticallyVerified} THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE NULL END, semantic_verification_note = #{semanticVerificationNote}, is_enabled = CASE WHEN #{semanticallyVerified} AND #{sourceBoardTypeCode} <> 'UNVERIFIED' AND #{collectionPolicyCode} <> 'EXCLUDED' THEN is_enabled ELSE false END, collection_status_code = CASE WHEN NOT #{semanticallyVerified} OR #{sourceBoardTypeCode} = 'UNVERIFIED' OR #{collectionPolicyCode} = 'EXCLUDED' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN #{validationStatusCode} = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'READY' ELSE 'CHECK_REQUIRED' END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

-- Enable only a verified source whose system-managed automatic collection is ready. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources SET is_enabled = #{enabled}, collection_status_code = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 'READY' ELSE 'DISABLED' END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ( NOT #{enabled} OR ( validation_status_code = 'VERIFIED' AND parser_profile_code IS NOT NULL AND parser_profile_code <> 'MANUAL_ONLY' AND is_semantically_verified = true AND source_board_type_code <> 'UNVERIFIED' AND collection_policy_code <> 'EXCLUDED' ) )

-- Soft delete a local-government notice source and stop collection. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources SET is_enabled = false, collection_status_code = 'DISABLED', deleted_at = now(), updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select:
-- Select local-government notice source registry. SELECT FROM local_government_notice_sources lgns
ORDER BY lgns.sido_name ASC, lgns.sigungu_name ASC, lgns.public_code ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count local-government notice source registry. SELECT count(1) FROM local_government_notice_sources lgns

-- Select local-government notice source details. SELECT FROM local_government_notice_sources lgns
WHERE lgns.id = #{sourceId} AND lgns.deleted_at IS NULL

-- Select enabled static semantic keyword rules in deterministic order. SELECT rule_code, rule_type_code, keyword_text, sort_order FROM announcement_source_semantic_keyword_rules WHERE is_enabled = true ORDER BY rule_type_code ASC, sort_order ASC, rule_code ASC

-- Select parser profiles available to operators. SELECT profile_code, profile_name, parser_type_code, list_item_selector, title_selector, date_selector, link_selector, date_pattern, response_type_code, json_items_path, json_title_field, json_date_field, json_link_field, json_link_template, link_strategy_code, link_function_name, link_function_argument_count, link_url_template, is_enabled FROM local_government_notice_parser_profiles ORDER BY profile_name ASC, profile_code ASC

-- Select parser profile details for a collection attempt. SELECT profile_code, profile_name, parser_type_code, list_item_selector, title_selector, date_selector, link_selector, date_pattern, response_type_code, json_items_path, json_title_field, json_date_field, json_link_field, json_link_template, link_strategy_code, link_function_name, link_function_argument_count, link_url_template, is_enabled FROM local_government_notice_parser_profiles WHERE profile_code = #{profileCode}

-- Aggregate local-government source and review traffic-light counts. SELECT count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.is_enabled = true) AS enabled_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.collection_status_code IN ('SUCCESS', 'NO_CHANGE')) AS success_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.collection_status_code IN ('CHECK_REQUIRED', 'READY', 'DISABLED')) AS warning_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.collection_status_code IN ('FAILED', 'URL_ERROR', 'ACCESS_BLOCKED', 'PARSER_UNSUPPORTED')) AS failed_count, (SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass WHERE ass.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND ass.review_status_code IN ('REVIEW_PENDING', 'CONDITION_INPUT_REQUIRED') AND ass.semantic_status_code IN ('ACCEPTED', 'REVIEW_REQUIRED')) AS review_pending_count, count(1) FILTER ( WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.last_error_code IN ( 'RETRYABLE', 'NETWORK_ERROR', 'DNS_LOOKUP_FAILED', 'TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED', 'CONNECTION_REFUSED', 'CONNECTION_RESET', 'HTTP_ERROR', 'EMPTY_RESPONSE' ) ) AS transport_failure_count, count(1) FILTER ( WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.last_error_code IN ('PARSER_ERROR', 'PARSER_NOT_CONFIGURED', 'LIST_SELECTOR_NOT_MATCHED', 'HEURISTIC_ITEMS_NOT_FOUND', 'UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE', 'JSON_PARSER_NOT_CONFIGURED') ) AS parser_failure_count, count(1) FILTER ( WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( lgns.last_error_code IN ('REQUIRED_FIELDS_MISSING', 'JSON_REQUIRED_FIELDS_MISSING') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_collection_source_results partial_result WHERE partial_result.local_government_source_id = lgns.id AND partial_result.result_status_code = 'PARTIAL_FAILED' AND partial_result.started_at = ( SELECT max(latest_partial.started_at) FROM announcement_source_collection_source_results latest_partial WHERE latest_partial.local_government_source_id = lgns.id ) ) ) ) AS partial_fields_count, count(1) FILTER ( WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( NOT lgns.is_semantically_verified OR lgns.source_board_type_code IN ('UNVERIFIED', 'PRESS_RELEASE') OR lgns.collection_policy_code = 'EXCLUDED' ) ) AS semantic_mismatch_count, coalesce(( SELECT sum(latest_result.excluded_count) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (result.local_government_source_id) result.local_government_source_id, result.excluded_count FROM announcement_source_collection_source_results result ORDER BY result.local_government_source_id, result.started_at DESC, result.id DESC ) latest_result ), 0) AS irrelevant_content_count, count(1) FILTER ( WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT lgns.is_semantically_verified ) AS unverified_source_count FROM local_government_notice_sources lgns
mapper.insert: -- Store one collection result for each local-government URL in a run. INSERT INTO announcement_source_collection_source_results ( id, run_id, local_government_source_id, result_status_code, discovered_count, new_count, duplicate_count, failed_count, excluded_count, http_status, error_code, error_message, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{resultId}, #{runId}, #{sourceId}, #{resultStatusCode}, #{discoveredCount}, #{newCount}, #{duplicateCount}, #{failedCount}, #{excludedCount}, #{httpStatus}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (run_id, local_government_source_id) DO UPDATE SET result_status_code = excluded.result_status_code, discovered_count = excluded.discovered_count, new_count = excluded.new_count, duplicate_count = excluded.duplicate_count, failed_count = excluded.failed_count, excluded_count = excluded.excluded_count, http_status = excluded.http_status, error_code = excluded.error_code, error_message = excluded.error_message, finished_at = excluded.finished_at, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: -- Accumulate new and duplicate item counts after unified duplicate checks. UPDATE announcement_source_collection_source_results SET new_count = new_count + #{newIncrement}, duplicate_count = duplicate_count + #{duplicateIncrement}, excluded_count = excluded_count + #{excludedIncrement}, updated_at = now() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND local_government_source_id = #{sourceId}
mapper.sql: result.id AS result_id, result.run_id, run.public_code AS run_public_code, result.local_government_source_id AS source_id, source.public_code AS source_public_code, source.institution_name, source.notice_url, result.result_status_code, result.discovered_count, result.new_count, result.duplicate_count, result.failed_count, result.excluded_count, result.http_status, result.error_code, result.error_message, result.started_at, result.finished_at
mapper.select: -- Select URL-level collection diagnostics for one execution. SELECT FROM announcement_source_collection_source_results result INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_runs run ON run.id = result.run_id INNER JOIN local_government_notice_sources source ON source.id = result.local_government_source_id WHERE result.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY CASE result.result_status_code WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 0 WHEN 'URL_ERROR' THEN 0 WHEN 'ACCESS_BLOCKED' THEN 0 WHEN 'PARSER_UNSUPPORTED' THEN 0 WHEN 'PARTIAL_FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, source.sido_name ASC, source.sigungu_name ASC, source.public_code ASC

-- Select recent URL-level collection diagnostics for one source. SELECT FROM announcement_source_collection_source_results result INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_runs run ON run.id = result.run_id INNER JOIN local_government_notice_sources source ON source.id = result.local_government_source_id WHERE result.local_government_source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY result.started_at DESC, result.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count URL-level collection diagnostics for one source. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_collection_source_results WHERE local_government_source_id = #{sourceId}
mapper.update: -- Update last collection metadata without storing response bodies. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources SET collection_status_code = #{collectionStatusCode}, last_collected_at = now(), last_success_at = CASE WHEN #{success} THEN now() ELSE last_success_at END, last_http_status = #{httpStatus}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, etag = coalesce(#{etag}, etag), last_modified_value = coalesce(#{lastModifiedValue}, last_modified_value), last_content_fingerprint = coalesce(#{contentFingerprint}, last_content_fingerprint), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId}
mapper.select: -- Select collection schedules. SELECT FROM announcement_source_collection_schedules ass ORDER BY ass.created_at DESC, ass.public_code DESC
-- Select collection schedule details. SELECT FROM announcement_source_collection_schedules ass WHERE ass.id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.update: -- Apply server-validated schedule approval, pause, rejection, or expiry. UPDATE announcement_source_collection_schedules SET schedule_status_code = #{scheduleStatusCode}, approved_by = CASE WHEN #{scheduleStatusCode} = 'APPROVED' THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE approved_by END, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{scheduleStatusCode} = 'APPROVED' THEN now() ELSE approved_at END, approval_note = #{approvalNote}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.select: -- Select due approved schedules; execution-slot uniqueness prevents duplicate execution. SELECT FROM announcement_source_collection_schedules ass WHERE ass.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND ass.schedule_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND ass.next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND ass.next_run_at <= #{dueAt} ORDER BY ass.next_run_at ASC, ass.id ASC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: -- Update schedule execution result. UPDATE announcement_source_schedule_executions SET request_id = coalesce(#{requestId}, request_id), run_id = coalesce(#{runId}, run_id), execution_status_code = #{executionStatusCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{executionId}

-- Advance approved schedule after one claimed run. UPDATE announcement_source_collection_schedules SET last_run_at = #{lastRunAt}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{scheduleId} AND schedule_status_code = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select: -- Block QA cleanup when a collected local-government source is linked to an operational announcement. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_links asl INNER JOIN announcement_source_snapshots ass ON ass.id = asl.source_id WHERE ass.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND ass.data_purpose_code = 'QA'
mapper.delete: -- Delete only schedule executions linked to explicit QA requests or QA runs. DELETE FROM announcement_source_schedule_executions asse WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_collection_requests ascr WHERE ascr.id = asse.request_id AND ascr.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND ascr.data_purpose_code = 'QA' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_collection_runs ascrun INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_requests ascr ON ascr.id = ascrun.request_id WHERE ascrun.id = asse.run_id AND ascr.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND ascr.data_purpose_code = 'QA' )

-- Delete local-government collection runs; run items and source results cascade from the run. DELETE FROM announcement_source_collection_runs ascrun WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_collection_requests ascr WHERE ascr.id = ascrun.request_id AND ascr.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND ascr.data_purpose_code = 'QA' )

-- Delete local-government collection approval requests after their runs are removed. DELETE FROM announcement_source_collection_requests WHERE provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND data_purpose_code = 'QA'
-- Delete unlinked local-government source snapshots; dependent review data cascades. DELETE FROM announcement_source_snapshots WHERE provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND data_purpose_code = 'QA'
mapper.update: -- Reset only QA-only sources; never erase runtime evidence backed by production rows. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources lgns SET collection_status_code = CASE WHEN is_enabled THEN 'READY' ELSE 'DISABLED' END, last_collected_at = NULL, last_success_at = NULL, last_http_status = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, etag = NULL, last_modified_value = NULL, last_content_fingerprint = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_snapshots qa_snapshot WHERE qa_snapshot.local_government_source_id = lgns.id AND qa_snapshot.data_purpose_code = 'QA' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_collection_source_results qa_result INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_runs qa_run ON qa_run.id = qa_result.run_id INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_requests qa_request ON qa_request.id = qa_run.request_id WHERE qa_result.local_government_source_id = lgns.id AND qa_request.data_purpose_code = 'QA' ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_snapshots production_snapshot WHERE production_snapshot.local_government_source_id = lgns.id AND production_snapshot.data_purpose_code = 'PRODUCTION' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_collection_source_results production_result INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_runs production_run ON production_run.id = production_result.run_id INNER JOIN announcement_source_collection_requests production_request ON production_request.id = production_run.request_id WHERE production_result.local_government_source_id = lgns.id AND production_request.data_purpose_code = 'PRODUCTION' )
